title: Literal mall dream
content: I’ve been at my dream mall often lately I’m even working there part time lol. Insane. Anyway. There’s a Levi store on the lower floor at an intersection where escalators are. The people there let me cut through there to the back parking lot all the time. Any of y’all working at Levi’s?! Why is it so specific? It’s so real, a world in my dreams that I know the layout of and the people in it. It’s this kind of shit that makes me need to think there’s something else to dreams.
